create_signal_sparsity_config: create a SignalSparsity config with FFT algo and top-k percent for SST and DST sparsification
compress_tensor_with_lossy_compress: compress a PyTorch tensor using SignalSparsity lossy_compress to get SST and DST sparse tensors
transform_dense_to_sst: transform a dense tensor to a signal sparse tensor using dense_to_sst with FFT and top-k
reconstruct_dense_from_sst_dst: reconstruct a dense tensor from SST and DST sparse tensors using sst_dst_to_dense
generate_random_sparse_mask: generate a random sparse mask tensor with a given percent of non-zeros along a dimension
